options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: lun
options.description: The LUN value you wish to give the mapping. If the supplied I(volume_name) is associated with a different LUN, it will be updated to what is supplied here. LUN value will be determine by the storage-system when not specified.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Present will ensure the mapping exists, absent will remove the mapping.

options.name: target
options.description: The name of host or hostgroup you wish to assign to the mapping If omitted, the default hostgroup is used. If the supplied I(volume_name) is associated with a different target, it will be updated to what is supplied here.

options.name: volume_name
options.description: The name of the volume you wish to include in the mapping. Use ACCESS_VOLUME to reference the in-band access management volume.
